articles.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
articles.snippet: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

articles.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
articles.snippet: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

articles.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
articles.snippet: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

articles.title: Binance arranges $6.34 billion to cover losses from record crypto hack
articles.snippet: Binance said it reserved its own funds to cover the $6.3 billion hack, including freezes of roughly $3 billion in stolen assets.
